blocks.text: Quira Quizon, the 18-year-old daughter of Vandolph and grandchild of the late King of Comedy Dolphy, opened up about her cancer battle, expressing hope for recovery and getting “more of [her] life back.” Quira, who has been diagnosed with lymphoma, spoke about this through her Facebook page, showing photos of herself. including one taken during her hospitalization. “Being diagnosed with cancer has changed so much about the way I see life. What I thought would be ordinary days became hospital visits, medications, procedures, and sleepless nights,” she said. “There have been times when my body felt like it was giving up […]...
